title: Going to the Doctor
text:
Sometimes people get sick. When Anna has a cold, she stays in bed and drinks warm tea. Her mother gives her medicine and says she must rest.

After three days, Anna feels better. She goes to the doctor for a check-up. The doctor says she is healthy now, and Anna can go back to school on Monday.

questions.text: What does Anna drink when she has a cold?
When can Anna go back to school?
What can you infer about Anna's mother from the passage?
options: She wants Anna to rest and get better.
She wants Anna to go to school sick.
She does not care about Anna's health.

questions.text: What can you infer about Anna's health at the end of the passage?
options: She needs to stay in bed for a month.
She has to go to hospital.

vocabulary.definition: a substance that you take to make an illness better
to stop working or moving and relax
in good physical condition, not ill
a visit to a doctor to see if you are well

paragraph_translations: Іноді люди хворіють. Коли в Ани застуда, вона лежить у ліжку і п'є теплий чай. Її мама дає їй ліки і каже, що вона має відпочивати.
Через три дні Ана почувається краще. Вона йде до лікаря на медичний огляд. Лікар каже, що тепер вона здорова, і Ана може повернутися до школи в понеділок.
